svg.aria-label: Diagram contrasting two ways of enforcing read-only in an MCP server. In the broken model, an agent sends SQL to the server, a validation component checks it against a list of disallowed inputs, and the query then runs against the database using a broadly privileged role — so a statement the list does not cover writes data. In the durable model, the same validator exists but the database role holds only CONNECT, USAGE and SELECT, so a missed statement fails at the database and the validator being wrong changes nothing. At the bottom, the three bulletins AWS published on the same day, all the same shape: an incomplete list of disallowed SQL, a template engine that did not neutralise special elements, and an incomplete fix for an earlier issue.
svg.title: Why a read-only MCP server enforced by a denylist fails, and where the guarantee belongs instead
svg.text: "Read-only" was a list of things not to allow
The list was incomplete, which is the only way lists of this kind ever end.
What CVE-2026-85787 describes
Agent sends SQL to the MCP server
SQL validation component
checks it against a list of disallowed inputs
Runs against the database as a role that
can write
One statement the list does not cover, and the data changes.
What AWS recommends alongside the patch
Agent sends SQL to the MCP server
Same validator, still imperfect — and now
it does not have to be right.
Database role holds CONNECT, USAGE, SELECT
A write fails at the database, not at the check.
Read-only enforced where read-only is a real primitive.
Three bulletins the same day, three versions of the same mistake
CVE-2026-85787 — postgres-mcp-server below 1.1.7
An incomplete list of disallowed inputs in the SQL validation component. Crafted SQL modifies data beyond the read-only scope.
CVE-2026-85654 — dynamodb-mcp-server 2.0.10 to 2.1.5
Special elements not neutralised in the CDK generator's template engine. A crafted table name becomes code on the deploying host.
CVE-2026-85786 — ion-java
An incomplete fix for CVE-2026-75936. The first list of cases to handle was also not complete.
A fourth, CVE-2026-85781, covers unverified access point ownership in the Amazon EFS CSI Driver.
